text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after Vivlos took a day off,
the two of us were having a meeting, when—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... I was helping a friend with fashion advice
until late last night~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...I hope my advice helped boost their confidence a bit...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: And so~ since I'm pretty tired~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainie, can I have a lap pillow, pleeease?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I politely declined while expressing concern over their lack of sleep.
